beats.intent: Voice the objection the audience already holds, as the persona's own past belief. No product name.
beats.example: חשבתי שכל קרמי הפנים זה אותו סיפור

beats.intent: One honest reason the doubt was reasonable. This beat buys the trust.
beats.example: כי ניסיתי כל מיני מותגים וכולם אכזבו אותי

beats.intent: The earned reveal moment — an exception exists, and she is relieved she found it. STILL UNNAMED. This beat is what makes the name feel like a discovery rather than an insertion.
beats.example: חוץ מקרם אחד, שתודה לאל שמצאתי אותו

beats.intent: Name it, then the advantages immediately after, then ONE of the closers offered in the prompt, copied with its punctuation. The example shows one closer; use whichever the prompt offers this time. Nothing after it — never add reassurance like 'את לא תתחרטי', it reads as fake straight after a name drop.
beats.example: הוא נקרא עולא ביוטי, מיוצר בגרמניה, מתאים לכל סוגי העור וממש איכותי. חבל על הזמן..

notes: The highest-trust structure and the best fit for a crowded category. Requires at least one genuinely specific advantage; without it the exception beat collapses into generic praise.
